Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.

{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Ticket:
Token authentication failing during controlled substance setup

I am having endless trouble trying to finish setting up my controlled substance prescribing credentials. Every single time I enter my security token during the final signing step, the software rejects it and loops me back to the beginning. I've wasted an hour on this already. Please fix whatever is blocking my token authentication.
